evidence: Let q=L/gcd(L,2). Standard induced character and normalized convolution give ||P_lambda||=(1/L)sum_{j mod L}|lambda(j)+lambda(j)^-1|=(1/q)sum_{k mod q}|1+exp(2pi ik/q)|.
The right hand side is exactly ||P_{2,q}|| from the all-m theorem at m=2, and equals 2S_q/q with the S_q from the October 4 theorem.
For q odd: 2csc(pi/(2q))/q; q even: 2cot(pi/(2q))/q. Substituting q=L for L odd, q=L/2 for L even yields all three displayed C_L cases.
From the triangle inequality for 1+zeta_q^k, ||P_{2,q}||=1 only when q=2 (for q>=2); q=2 iff L=4 because L>=3. The exponent criterion is elementary finite-abelian duality.
The three Taylor coefficients are elementary expansions of the already-available exact formulas.

originality.rationale: The already-published 2026-10-04 exact two-frequency finite-cyclic finding evaluates S_q=sum_{j=0}^{q-1}|cos(pi*j/q)| for ALL q, including the even/odd closed forms. The published all-m finite-cyclic Fourier-projection theorem also directly includes m=2. For a generalized-dihedral two-dimensional irrep induced from lambda of order L, standard finite-group central-idempotent/induced-character formulas give a kernel 4 Re lambda on A and zero on its reflection coset. With q=L/gcd(L,2), the endpoint norm is EXACTLY ||P_{2,q}||=(2/q)S_q, with no new nonstandard ingredient. Hence ALL quantitative norm cases, expansions, and the norm-one classification are mathematical consequences of the prior cyclic formulas plus textbook induction and Fourier inversion. Dai--Li Theorem 2.2 already explicitly calculates the primitive central dihedral idempotents. The comparison is implication coverage, not mere topical similarity, and no distinct original theorem remains.

value.rationale: The question is motivated: sharp endpoint norms of individual nonlinear irreducible Fourier blocks are natural. But the answer is a mechanical pullback of the already explicit two-frequency cyclic norm S_q (published 2026-10-04), under the standard two-dimensional induced-character and central-idempotent formulas. It adds no new estimate, obstruction, classification beyond immediate parameter conversion, or separately unresolved mathematical difficulty. The exact q-invariant is already known, so this is a routine substitution/renaming rather than a distinct valuable mathematical finding. This judgment does not reject finite or self-contained work as such; it rejects this specifically pre-implied calculation.
residual_risks: A distinctive pedagogical synthesis could be useful, but expository utility alone does not meet mathematical-value requirements for an original theorem.
